task: Initialize the unified Rust CLI, port the legacy TypeScript CLI under sno station, create the private GitHub repository, and prepare real crates.io, npm, and PyPI releases with a pre-publish review gate

q1.evidence: No durable application data write path; only local configuration and registry publishing

q2.evidence: Command namespace, crate name, packaging targets, license, repository visibility, and pre-publish review gate are settled

q3.evidence: Creates published CLI and package contracts across crates.io, npm, and PyPI

q4.evidence: Greenfield repository plus cross-repo TypeScript-to-Rust port across four release systems

q5.evidence: Behavior can be validated with deterministic tests plus real registry and install smoke checks

decision: Hard-cut distribution to Rust only: crates.io plus seven GitHub native archives; remove npm, PyPI, Node.js, and Python wrappers
evidence: Owner direction on 2026-07-15 PDT; production workflow now gates five native families and two Linux musl variants
